title: Runtime path policy trusts caller-controlled project roots as confinement anchors
title_de: Runtime-Pfad-Policy vertraut caller-kontrollierten Projekt-Roots als Confinement-Ankern
summary: Runtime path helpers accepted mutable project-root values as trusted containment anchors. Setting a root to `/` classified descendants of `/etc` and `/root` as runtime-allowed; the resolver also accepted broad `/root/poc-*` bases.
summary_de: Runtime-Pfad-Helper akzeptierten veränderliche Projekt-Root-Werte als vertrauenswürdige Containment-Anker. Setzen eines Roots auf `/` klassifizierte Nachfahren von `/etc` und `/root` als Runtime-erlaubt; der Resolver akzeptierte außerdem breite `/root/poc-*`-Basen.
observed_behavior: `runtime_path_utils.py:50-98` derives trusted roots from mutable environment inputs. A side-effect-free probe classified `/etc/evidence-escape` and `/root/evidence-escape` as allowed when project roots were `/`; the lifecycle resolver accepted five `/root/poc-*` bases without writing.
observed_behavior_de: `runtime_path_utils.py:50-98` leitet vertrauenswürdige Roots aus veränderlichen Environment-Inputs ab. Ein nebenwirkungsfreier Probe klassifizierte `/etc/evidence-escape` und `/root/evidence-escape` als erlaubt, wenn Projekt-Roots `/` waren; der Lifecycle-Resolver akzeptierte fünf `/root/poc-*`-Basen ohne Schreibvorgang.
expected_behavior: Project roots may not declassify arbitrary system-path descendants. Invocation-owned runtime bases must be canonical, safe children of a validated external task root; ordinary source roots remain read-only inputs.
expected_behavior_de: Projekt-Roots dürfen beliebige Systempfad-Nachfahren nicht deklassifizieren. Invocation-eigene Runtime-Basen müssen kanonische sichere Nachfahren eines validierten externen Task-Roots sein; gewöhnliche Source-Roots bleiben read-only Inputs.
impact: A local or future caller that controls path inputs can bypass intended containment and direct lifecycle artifacts toward broad system-user locations. Current workflows bind roots to runner temporary locations, so no untrusted pull-request expression reachability was proven.
impact_de: Ein lokaler oder zukünftiger Caller mit Kontrolle über Pfad-Inputs kann das beabsichtigte Containment umgehen und Lifecycle-Artefakte in breite System-User-Locations lenken. Aktuelle Workflows binden Roots an Runner-Temporary-Locations; eine untrusted Pull-Request-Expression-Reachability wurde nicht bewiesen.
preconditions: A caller can provide project or lifecycle root inputs.
The path helper is used before a runtime artifact write.
reproduction: Call the side-effect-free runtime path helper with `REPO_ROOT=/`, `CONNECTOR_ROOT=/`, and `FRAMEWORK_ROOT=/` and inspect `/etc/evidence-escape` and `/root/evidence-escape` classifications.
Run the lifecycle resolver with `/root/poc-*` bases and observe successful resolution without writes.
Use a distinct task-owned external root as the legitimate control.

evidence.command: rtk env PYTHONPATH=/root/git/ModSecurity-conector/ci/lib PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 .venv/bin/python <side-effect-free path probe>; retained resolver probes

root_cause: The policy uses caller-controlled project roots as positive authorization anchors instead of constraining runtime paths to a single invocation-owned external root.
root_cause_de: Die Policy verwendet caller-kontrollierte Projekt-Roots als positive Autorisierungsanker, statt Runtime-Pfade auf einen einzigen invocation-eigenen externen Root zu beschränken.
proposed_remediation: Reject broad/system bases and environment-derived project roots for writable runtime paths. Resolve every writable lifecycle base against a validated invocation root and retain explicit read-only source-root handling separately.
proposed_remediation_de: Breite/System-Basen und environment-abgeleitete Projekt-Roots für beschreibbare Runtime-Pfade ablehnen. Jede beschreibbare Lifecycle-Basis gegen einen validierten Invocation-Root auflösen und explizite read-only Source-Root-Behandlung getrennt beibehalten.
acceptance_criteria: `/`, `/etc`, `/root`, and their descendants cannot become writable runtime roots through project-root input values.
Symlink, traversal, and mixed-root escapes fail closed after canonicalization.
A distinct safe run layout beneath the task-owned external root remains accepted.
Current workflow-owned runner temporary layouts remain supported.
validation_plan: Add path-escape fixtures before the source fix, including project roots set to `/` and a lexical traversal/symlink alternative.
Run helper and lifecycle-resolver negative/control tests without writing to system paths.
Run the focused runtime-path and lifecycle test suites plus security diff scan.
regression_tests: Focused runtime_path_utils tests for broad project-root rejection.
Focused resolve-runtime-paths tests for canonical task-root containment.
legitimate_control_tests: A safe connector run layout below a task-owned external root resolves successfully.
Read-only project-source paths remain usable where explicitly required.
